nom: DIME Hyper Glow Vitamin C Serum

avis.texte: I bought this serum in large part because it is clearly pictured as being packaged in a sealed pump-top bottle which is much better for the sterility and longevity of the product. Vitamin C, being an antioxidant, is very sensitive to oxygen and loses potency quickly when repeatedly exposed to air. Misleading advertising wasted my time. I'll be returning this one.
I have sensitive skin and Rosacea. This is the first Vit C serum I can use that doesn't burn
I got this serum because it uses l-ascorbic acid, which is super powerful, and otehr ingredients similar to skinceuticals' vitamin c serum - but without all the toxic ingredients!!

I LOVE this serum! I buy it with my own money and have used it for over a year so trust me when I say this stuff will make your skin glow! Dullness is gone and skin is hydrated all with zero irritation and a nice lightweight texture. Keeping this product in your fridge fixes all of the complaints about oxidation and boy is that small step worth it! I have searched high and low and no one else has the powerhouse of Vit C, ferulic, AND resveratrol (plus added hydrators) in 1 serum. This product has literally replaced 3 other serums in my routine and is a holy grail for me.
Love this stuff!! Goes on and runs in easy. I do wish I saw more of a drastic improvement in evening out skin tone, but I do think I've seen an improvement overall.
This product has helped my skin glow in a new way. I apply before my moisturizer and it makes my skin GLOW!
Third step take in morning routine prior to dewy day cream and sunblock Goes on smoothly. Not greasy Gives glow
This is my favorite DIME product. Very high-quality and makes my skin glow. Can be a little stingy if your skin is sensitive, but I would just say avoid it if you're like sunburned or something.
I recently added this to my routine and love it! I feel like it really gives my skin the boost it deserves
This brightens the skins and leaves it looking bright and youthful.
Love this Vitamin C serum! Previous ones I've tried were sticky and I didn't see much of a difference. This isn't sticky and my skin is brighter!
Use this in combination with the Hyaluronic serum every morning and night. Leaves my skin so hydrated and smooth! 10/10 recommend
I haven't had it very long, but my skin does feel brighter and tighter
Such a great product to get that natural glow. You can definitely put this on and go without makeup and feel refreshed and bright.
I have been using this serum for 2 years now; love the natural glow it leaves so I don't need makeup.
The quality and the luxuriousness of the texture of this serum is noticeable immediately
Love using this in my morning DIME routine. Wakes up my skin, giving a fresh glow! Makes me feel ready to face the day.

I had been using a much more expensive vitamin C serum for a few years prior to trying this one and I'll never go back! I have good genes in my family and have always looked younger than my actual age. I'm confident that as long as I keep using this product that will not change!
My face is not as dry as it was. I've also noticed my age spots have lightened.

I absolutely love this serum. I have not found anything else that makes my skin feel such relief. I have dry and sensitive skin that gets easily red, this helps eliminate the redness without further sensitivity. My skin feels brighter and softer.
I had purchased this multiple times and will continue to. It's really nice and light on the skin and it does produce a little "glow" after applying. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Really yellow and not serum like more of watery

Also, it is in a black bottle which makes it last much longer. Other C serums I have tried go bad before I can finish the bottle.
Best serum! It soaks in instantly. It's not oily or greasy-leaves a beautiful glow!

This is a must have/use when using the TBT crème. My skin is so much more firm with less fine lines since I started using the combo a couple of years ago
